title: 7-round AES-256: Split-variable selected-subkey recovery

target.description: AES-256 on 128-bit blocks. Seven-round prefix with initial whitening and final MixColumns omitted. The source explicitly specifies left-going ShiftRows. The procedure returns kini (four initial bytes), k_tau1 and k_tau2 (twenty last/penultimate-round bytes or linear combinations). This record covers that selected-key-material output.

setting.key_relation: One unknown standard AES master key; no related-key or known-key access.
setting.key_population: general secret key; no restriction to a weak-key family
setting.plaintext_model: A 2^32 chosen-plaintext structure varying four initial bytes with the other twelve fixed.
assumptions: A random32-bit model for the four internal parameters supports the birthday estimate. Sixteen-value preliminary matches are checked over all256 y values.

time.reported: 2^144 AES executions in abstract; about2^144 cheaper operations in Section5.3
time.note: The abstract and detailed body use different native units. Data acquisition additionally executes the chosen-plaintext oracle2^32 times; no scalar end-to-end conversion is selected.

success.description: The source estimates about one-half chance that the sampled c values yield a useful function collision and return kini,k_tau1,k_tau2. This metric concerns the explicitly returned key material.
